name: Code Blue
storyline:
Start with a doctor's office and build your way to a national hospital. Code Blue is a single-player hospital construction and management simulation where your building layout, staff, and infrastructure all shape patient care.

Every expansion brings new possibilities and new demands. Opening a ward means finding beds, nurses, and supplies. Adding surgery means preparing an entire service to work together. Decide what your hospital can handle, then make sure it can deliver.
summary: Build and manage a hospital with a detailed medical simulation. Design wards, develop your staff, and keep supplies and utilities flowing as patients' conditions change over time. Grow from a doctor's office into a national hospital, ready for the next emergency.
